jp: ついさっき、\n別れたばかりなのに
en: But we only just parted a moment ago...

jp: ねねちゃん、\n居間で何か言って\nいませんでしたか？
en: Did Nene-chan say anything in the living room?

jp: そのまま、\n２階へ向かわれた\nようですが
en: She seemed to head straight up to the second floor, though.
Who on earth would do such a thing...
It's the work of the $c02Ouma$c00, I tell you!

jp: この家は\n狙われとるんじゃ！
ああ、\n上から放り込まれた\nみたいだね
en: Yes, looks like she was thrown in from above.

jp: 竹さん、\n$c02逢魔$c00の仕業だって\n言ってるけど
en: Take-san says it's the work of the $c02Ouma$c00, but...

jp: 小婆ちゃん、\n$c02逢魔$c00の仕業との叫び
今度もまたまたまた\n$c02逢魔$c00の仕業？
en: This time again, again, again, the $c02Ouma$c00's doing?

jp: 竹が、\n$c02逢魔$c00の仕業だって\n騒いでるけど
en: Take is making a fuss that it's the $c02Ouma$c00's doing, but...

jp: うん、\n$c02逢魔$c00の仕業には\n違いないけど、
en: Yes, it's certainly the $c02Ouma$c00's doing, but

jp: 必ず操られている\n人間がいるはずさ
en: there's bound to be a human being who's being manipulated.

jp: ふみゅ。\nではまたまたまた\n犯人探して倒そう
en: Fumyu. Then again, again, again: find culprit, defeat.

jp: 今の再演、\n麟は、何かに気づいて\nいたようだよ
en: In that replay just now, Rin seemed to notice something.

jp: 今度の事件は、\n割と早く\n解決しそうだね
en: This case looks like it'll be solved fairly quickly.

jp: 【ねねの遺体】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
【麟の疑問】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
